title: 第15章 金丹大道第16章 世间再无冠军侯
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
那种痛苦，让人神魂俱灭。
但顾长青的道心，早已在百年的孤独与等待中，被打磨得，如同一块万古不化的玄冰。
他死死守住那一点灵台清明，任由那无边的痛苦冲刷，神魂却不动如山。
他知道，这是破而后立，必经的过程。
不将旧的道台彻底击碎，化为最本源的精气，就无法凝聚出，那超越凡俗，象征着永恒的，金丹！
磅礴的灵气，如同奔涌的江河，疯狂地涌入他的体内，修复着他因为碎丹而不断受损的经脉和肉身，同时，也加速着道台的崩解。
一切，都在按照他预想的轨迹，有条不紊地进行着。
只要再过一个时辰，他的筑基道台，便会彻底化为齑粉。
届时，他便可以开始，凝聚金丹的最后一步。
然而，就在这时。
“轰！！！”
一声沉闷的巨响，猛地从地宫之外传来，穿透了层层阻碍，清晰地传递到了他的神魂之中。
顾长青的心神，猛地一震。
“怎么回事？！”
他心中大惊。
这地宫，是他耗费了十年心血，打造的绝对安全之所。
三道万斤断龙石，足以抵挡千军万马。
外面，还有他最信任的国相，在处理一切。
按理说，绝不可能，有任何东西，能打扰到他才对！
“轰！轰！轰！”

接连不断的撞击声，再次传来。
每一次撞击，都让整个地宫，发生轻微的震颤。
也让那正在运转的周天-星斗大阵，出现了，极其微弱的能量紊乱。
“有人在强行破陵！”
顾长青瞬间就明白了过来。
他的脸色，变得无比难看。
到底是谁？！
是长安的那位皇帝？
他竟然，真的不顾一切，做出了这种掘墓鞭尸的事情！
“该死！”
顾长青心中，第一次，涌起了滔天的怒火。
他算计了一切，算计了人心，算计了帝王的猜忌与贪婪。
却唯独没有算到，刘彻的行事，竟然会如此的，不计后果，如此的，疯狂！
这一下，彻底打乱了他的所有计划。
周天星斗大阵，与他的心神相连。
外界的每一次撞击，都一记重锤，砸在他的神魂之上。
content_en:
That kind of pain is so mind-numbing.
But Gu Changqing's Taoist heart has been polished by hundreds of years of loneliness and waiting, like a piece of eternal ice.
He clung to the clarity of the spiritual platform and allowed the boundless pain to wash away, but his soul remained motionless.
He knows that this is a necessary process for breaking down and then building up again.
Without completely smashing the old Taoist platform and turning it into the most original essence, it is impossible to condense the golden elixir that transcends the ordinary and symbolizes eternity!
The majestic spiritual energy, like a rushing river, poured into his body crazily, repairing his meridians and body that were constantly damaged by the Broken Pill, and at the same time, accelerating the disintegration of the Taoist platform.
Everything was proceeding in an orderly manner according to the trajectory he expected.
In just one hour, his foundation-building platform will be completely reduced to dust.
At that time, he can begin the final step of condensing the golden elixir.
However, at this moment.
"Boom!!!"
A dull loud noise suddenly came from outside the underground palace, penetrating through layers of obstacles and clearly reaching his soul.
Gu Changqing's mind was suddenly shaken.
"What's going on?!"
He was shocked.
This underground palace is an absolutely safe place that he spent ten years of hard work building.
Three thousand kilograms of broken dragon stones are enough to withstand thousands of troops.
Outside, there is his most trusted prime minister, handling everything.
Logically speaking, it is absolutely impossible for anything to disturb him!
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Continuous crashing sounds came again.
Every impact caused the entire underground palace to tremble slightly.
It also caused extremely weak energy chaos to appear in the Zhoutian-Xingdou array that was running.
"Someone is forcibly destroying the tomb!"
Gu Changqing understood instantly.
His face became extremely ugly.
Who is it? !
Is it the emperor of Chang'an?
He actually, really desperate, did this kind of thing like digging graves and whipping corpses!
"Damn it!"
For the first time, Gu Changqing's heart surged with overwhelming anger.
He calculated everything, calculated people's hearts, and calculated the emperor's suspicion and greed.
But what he didn't expect was that Liu Che's behavior would be so reckless, so crazy!
This completely disrupted all his plans.
The Zhoutian Xingdou Formation was connected to his mind.
Every impact from the outside world was a heavy hammer hitting his soul.
